text:
maria-partnerships: hey team — onboarding CloudSphere for the new eastfield region. need to confirm marketplace SKU entitlements, KMS handoff timing, and whether we have approval to publish joint announcement. cc @kevin-sales @anais-partner-success
jon-eng-ops: thanks. can you drop the target SKUs + expected qps? I can run capacity gating after that.
sahil-ops: FYI eastfield has a soft quota cap from CS of 100 vGPUs by default. we need a quota increase request 48-72h before go-live.
maria-partnerships: rough ask: CS-GPU-A100-v2 x20 for initial pool, plus CS-CPU-Medium x10 for control plane. QPS estimate ~120 rps sustained, burst 350.
jon-eng-ops: ok. i'll queue autoscaler profile and preflight tests. do we have the partner SKU IDs or marketplace SKU slugs?
mania whoops typo — anais-partner-success: SKU slugs below (exported from CloudSphere partner portal):
- cs.a100.v2.large
- cs.ctrl.medium
maria-partnerships: perfect — thanks @anais-partner-success. next: KMS. CloudSphere requires a partner-managed CMEK for marketplace images. @eva-legal any must-have contract language for CMEK key sharing?
eva-legal: short answer: we cannot hand over our master key. partner-managed CMEK allowed if customer BYOK. For marketplace listing we need an addendum that states: partner holds tenant-level keys and we do not export logs with key material. i'll draft a 1-paragraph addendum. ETA 24h.
kevin-sales: timeline from partner side — CloudSphere ops asked for a joint press window w/in 2 weeks of capacity confirmation. can we hit that?
sahil-ops: operationally, if quota increase is requested today and approved in 48h, we can do a soft-lift in 72h, but hard SLA-backed Dedicated pools take 2 weeks (procurement + presigned certs).
jon-eng-ops: blockers: 1) quota ticket to CS portal, 2) test image with CMEK integration, 3) routing policy in infra config for eastfield region. I can push infra PR once we have the SKU slugs and quota ticket id.
maria-partnerships: i'll open the quota ticket. using CloudSphere CLI:```bash
csctl quota request --region eastfield --sku cs.a100.v2.large --qty 20 --reason "Redwood Dedicated initial pool for partner launch"
```
maria-partnerships: ticket created: CS-TKT-8921 (put in description link to this thread). pls reference. @jon-eng-ops @sahil-ops
jon-eng-ops: got CS-TKT-8921. starting preflight job. sharing test matrix shortly.
anais-partner-success: integration testing note — partner wants a smoke test run that includes model pull + inference < 150ms p50. will coordinate test times with their ops.
eva-legal: also add embargo clause: no public announcement before both parties sign the addendum and confirm capacity. will add language to draft.
kevin-sales: i'll sync with partner marketing to prepare joint asset folder. hold on announcement until ops confirms test pass. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment checklist created for region eastfield: r/infrastructure/regions/eastfield/checks — status: pending (autoscaler, routing, certs, kms).
sahil-ops: quick note on cost: A100-v2 pricing on CS is dynamic; recommend we set up a temporary cost limit alert for the pool during ramp to avoid surprises.
maria-partnerships: agree. @jon-eng-ops can you add budget alert and tag the resources with partner:cloudsphere?
jon-eng-ops: yes. PR to infra repo will include tags and budget alert.
maria-partnerships: timeline check: quota ticket open now (CS-TKT-8921), legal addendum draft by @eva-legal in 24h, infra PR by @jon-eng-ops in 36h, partner smoke test scheduled by @anais-partner-success within 72h. if all green, target soft-launch announcement 7 days from now. any objections?
eva-legal: no objections. will ping when draft is ready.
kevin-sales: good. i'll hold public comms.
anais-partner-success: i'll confirm test window w/ CloudSphere ops and share calendar invite.
sahil-ops: will monitor quota ticket and standby for escalation if CS asks for more info.
maria-partnerships: thanks everyone. i'll post updates here. tagging this thread for tracking: #eastfield-partner-onboard
kevin-sales: one last ask — can marketing get a partner logo + short blurb from CloudSphere for the marketplace tile? anais to follow up.
anais-partner-success: on it. collecting assets now.
jon-eng-ops: preflight matrix (short):
1) Provision reserved pool (20x a100-v2)
2) Verify CMEK-backed images pull
3) Run perf smoke (50 requests, p50 <150ms)
4) Validate autoscaler reacts to 500rps burst
5) Check routing fallback to eu-west if capacity exhausted
6) Confirm billing tags and alerts

maria-partnerships: beautiful. closing loop — next update in ~24h when legal has draft + quota status. :pray:
